summary.zh: 让内容更容易被 AI 回答引擎引用
summary.en: Make content easier for AI answer engines to cite

description.zh: 按 AI 回答引擎的偏好评估内容的可信度与结构，指出被引用概率低的原因并给出改写建议，同时可以记录引用情况。适合希望内容出现在 ChatGPT、Perplexity、Claude 或 Gemini 的回答里时使用。
description.en: Scores content for credibility and structure the way AI answer engines pick sources, explains weak spots, suggests rewrites and logs citations. Use it to get pages cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude or Gemini.
